title: Family Christmas Eve, Tree Tinsel Decor - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
TAKEN Just before PASSING OUT Xmas Eve
8 456
description: A humorous and candid mid-1950s family Christmas Eve portrait captured on the floor of a domestic living room. A mother wearing stylish cat-eye spectacles and a knit turtleneck sits beside the father, who wears a light fedora hat and holds their two drowsy young children on his lap. Directly behind them stands a Christmas tree adorned with heavy silver tinsel icicles and round glass baubles, while a decorative wire mesh screen rests beside them on a floral patterned rug. A cheeky handwritten note on the back quips that the photo was taken just before someone passed out.
